A 探针完整输入文件 probe_fuzz.py以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："#!/usr/bin/env python3\n# Independent randomized probe for side A: 80 random perturbations\n# (modify / truncate / append). Counts how often the first untrusted offset\n# fails to land on the changed line's start and how often the incremental\n# path disagrees with the full scan. Exits 0 only for zero errors.\nimport os, random, re, subprocess, sys\n\n\ndef make_base():\n    nl = b\"\\n\"\n    parts = []\n    for i in range(3000):\n        if i % 7 == 0:\n            parts.append((\"%04d 用户=张三 emoji🚀 tail\" % i).encode() + nl)\n        elif i % 11 == 0:\n            parts.append((\"%04d \" % i).encode() + (\"长\" * 300).encode() + nl)\n        elif i == 2999:\n            parts.append((\"%04d final no newline\" % i).encode())\n        else:\n            parts.append((\"%04d line %d data\" % (i, i)).encode() + nl)\n    return b\"\".join(parts)\n\n\ndef main():\n    cli, work = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]\n    os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)\n    base = make_base()\n    starts, p = [], 0\n    for ln in base.split(b\"\\n\")[:-1]:\n        starts.append(p)\n        p += len(ln) + 1\n\n    def line_start(pos):\n        s = 0\n        for st in starts:\n            if st <= pos:\n                s = st\n            else:\n                break\n        return s\n\n    def first_diff(a, b):\n        m = min(len(a), len(b))\n        for i in range(m):\n            if a[i] != b[i]:\n                return i\n        return m\n\n    log = os.path.join(work, \"f.log\")\n    idx = os.path.join(work, \"f.tidx\")\n\n    def run(args):\n        r = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True)\n        return r.stdout + r.stderr\n\n    random.seed(2026)\n    err = xc = 0\n    trials = 80\n    for _ in range(trials):\n        op = random.choice([\"mod\", \"trunc\", \"append\"])\n        if op == \"mod\":\n            b = bytearray(base)\n            pos = random.randrange(len(b))\n            b[pos] ^= 0x20\n            new = bytes(b)\n        elif op == \"trunc\":\n            new = base[:random.randrange(1, len(base))]\n        else:\n            new = base + ((\"追加行\".encode() + b\"\\n\") if random.random() < 0.5 else b\"tail-no-nl\")\n        open(log, \"wb\").write(base)\n        run([cli, \"index\", \"-o\", idx, log])\n        open(log, \"wb\").write(new)\n        out = run([cli, \"verify\", \"-i\", idx, log])\n        if \"cross-check: agree\" not in out:\n            xc += 1\n        m = re.search(r\"first untrusted offset: (\\d+)\", out)\n        afu = int(m.group(1)) if m else None\n        if op != \"append\":\n            gt = first_diff(base, new)\n            ls = line_start(gt) if gt < len(base) else gt\n            if afu != ls:\n                err += 1\n    print(\"A fuzz: trials=%d first_untrusted_errors=%d crosscheck_disagreements=%d\"\n          % (trials, err, xc))\n    sys.exit(0 if (err == 0 and xc == 0) else 1)\n\n\nmain()\n"

A 探针完整输入文件 probe_indexsize.py以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："#!/usr/bin/env python3\n# Independent probe for side A's index footprint: builds a sidecar index with\n# the product CLI and reports its real on-disk size versus the log. The A\n# format records a fixed 44-byte entry per line (8 offset + 4 length +\n# 32-byte digest) after a 56-byte header, so the sidecar scales with line\n# count. Exits 1 (defect reproduced) when that is confirmed.\nimport os, re, subprocess, sys\n\n\ndef make_base():\n    nl = b\"\\n\"\n    parts = []\n    for i in range(3000):\n        if i % 7 == 0:\n            parts.append((\"%04d 用户=张三 emoji🚀 tail\" % i).encode() + nl)\n        elif i % 11 == 0:\n            parts.append((\"%04d \" % i).encode() + (\"长\" * 300).encode() + nl)\n        elif i == 2999:\n            parts.append((\"%04d final no newline\" % i).encode())\n        else:\n            parts.append((\"%04d line %d data\" % (i, i)).encode() + nl)\n    return b\"\".join(parts)\n\n\ndef main():\n    cli, work = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]\n    os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)\n    log = os.path.join(work, \"size.log\")\n    idx = os.path.join(work, \"size.tidx\")\n    open(log, \"wb\").write(make_base())\n    subprocess.run([cli, \"index\", \"-o\", idx, log], capture_output=True, text=True)\n    info = subprocess.run([cli, \"info\", \"-i\", idx, log], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout\n    lines = int(re.search(r\"lines: (\\d+)\", info).group(1))\n    L = os.path.getsize(log)\n    I = os.path.getsize(idx)\n    per = (I - 56) // lines\n    exact = (I == 56 + 44 * lines)\n    print(\"log_bytes=%d index_bytes=%d lines=%d\" % (L, I, lines))\n    print(\"index_bytes_per_line=%d digest_bytes_per_line=32 index_size_is_56_plus_44_per_line=%s\"\n          % (per, exact))\n    print(\"index_over_log_ratio=%.3f\" % (I / L))\n    if per == 44 and exact and I * 3 > L:\n        print(\"DEFECT: per-line 32-byte digest makes the sidecar index large\")\n        sys.exit(1)\n    print(\"NOT REPRODUCED\")\n    sys.exit(0)\n\n\nmain()\n"

A 探针完整输入文件 probe_localize.py以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："#!/usr/bin/env python3\n# Independent reproduction probe for side A: does `verify` place the first\n# untrusted offset exactly at the start of the changed line, and does the\n# incremental path agree with the full scan? Builds its own inputs; only runs\n# the prebuilt product CLI. Exits 0 only if every case matches.\nimport os, re, subprocess, sys\n\n\ndef make_base():\n    nl = b\"\\n\"\n    parts = []\n    for i in range(3000):\n        if i % 7 == 0:\n            parts.append((\"%04d 用户=张三 emoji🚀 tail\" % i).encode() + nl)\n        elif i % 11 == 0:\n            parts.append((\"%04d \" % i).encode() + (\"长\" * 300).encode() + nl)\n        elif i == 2999:\n            parts.append((\"%04d final no newline\" % i).encode())\n        else:\n            parts.append((\"%04d line %d data\" % (i, i)).encode() + nl)\n    return b\"\".join(parts)\n\n\ndef line_starts(data):\n    starts, p = [], 0\n    for ln in data.split(b\"\\n\")[:-1]:\n        starts.append(p)\n        p += len(ln) + 1\n    return starts\n\n\ndef main():\n    cli, work = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]\n    os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)\n    base = make_base()\n    starts = line_starts(base)\n    log = os.path.join(work, \"loc.log\")\n    idx = os.path.join(work, \"loc.tidx\")\n\n    def line_start(pos):\n        s = 0\n        for st in starts:\n            if st <= pos:\n                s = st\n            else:\n                break\n        return s\n\n    def run(args):\n        r = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True)\n        return r.stdout + r.stderr\n\n    l1500 = starts[1500]\n    l100 = starts[100]\n    ins = starts[500]\n    cut = l1500 + 3  # truncate in the middle of line 1500\n    cases = [\n        (\"modify@line1500\", \"mod\", base[:l1500] + bytes([base[l1500] ^ 0x20]) + base[l1500 + 1:]),\n        (\"modify@line100\", \"mod\", base[:l100] + bytes([base[l100] ^ 0x20]) + base[l100 + 1:]),\n        (\"truncate@%d\" % cut, \"trunc\", base[:cut]),\n        (\"insert8@%d\" % ins, \"insert\", base[:ins] + b\"INSERTED\" + base[ins:]),\n    ]\n\n    ok = 0\n    for name, kind, new in cases:\n        open(log, \"wb\").write(base)\n        run([cli, \"index\", \"-o\", idx, log])\n        open(log, \"wb\").write(new)\n        out = run([cli, \"verify\", \"-i\", idx, log])\n        m = re.search(r\"first untrusted offset: (\\d+)\", out)\n        got = int(m.group(1)) if m else -1\n        if kind == \"trunc\":\n            gt = cut\n        else:\n            gt = next(i for i in range(min(len(base), len(new))) if base[i] != new[i])\n        expect = line_start(gt)\n        agree = \"cross-check: agree\" in out\n        good = (got == expect and agree)\n        ok += 1 if good else 0\n        print(\"case=%-18s expect_first_untrusted=%-6d got=%-6d cross-check=%s %s\"\n              % (name, expect, got, \"agree\" if agree else \"MISMATCH\", \"PASS\" if good else \"FAIL\"))\n    print(\"A localization: %d/%d exact at line start, cross-check agree %d/%d\"\n          % (ok, len(cases), ok, len(cases)))\n    sys.exit(0 if ok == len(cases) else 1)\n\n\nmain()\n"

A 探针完整输入文件 warmup.sh以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# Pre-recording warmup: compile the product CLI from the (read-only) workspace\n# and the independent byte-counting probe, using a persistent GOCACHE under\n# this support directory so no compilation happens during the recording.\nset -euo pipefail\nWS=\"$1\"\nSUP=\"$2\"\nexport GOCACHE=\"$SUP/gocache\"\nexport GOPATH=\"$SUP/gopath\"\nmkdir -p \"$SUP/bin\" \"$SUP/gocache\" \"$SUP/gopath\"\n\n# 1) Build the product CLI straight from the workspace source (never modified).\n/usr/local/bin/go build -C \"$WS\" -buildvcs=false -o \"$SUP/bin/trajidx\" ./cmd/trajidx\necho \"CLI_BUILD_OK\"\n\n# 2) Build the probe module that imports the product's tidx package.\nd=\"$SUP/fullread\"\ncat > \"$d/go.mod\" <<EOF\nmodule fullreadprobe\n\ngo 1.21\n\nrequire trajidx v0.0.0\n\nreplace trajidx => $WS\nEOF\n/usr/local/bin/go build -C \"$d\" -buildvcs=false -o \"$SUP/bin/probe_fullread\" .\necho \"PROBE_BUILD_OK\"\n"

B 探针完整输入文件 probe_early_start_zero.py以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："#!/usr/bin/env python3\n# Independent, read-only reproduction probe for the trajidx (side B) artifact.\n# Checks that an early, non-zero-offset edit is localized at its own offset; the\n# checkpoint scheme may instead collapse the start to byte 0. Throwaway copy.\nimport os, re, subprocess, sys, shutil\n\n\ndef main():\n    support = sys.argv[1]\n    binp = os.path.join(support, \".cache\", \"bin\", \"trajidx\")\n    if not os.path.exists(binp):\n        print(\"probe setup error: missing prebuilt binary %s\" % binp)\n        return 4\n    work = os.path.join(support, \".cache\", \"scratch\", \"earlyzero\")\n    shutil.rmtree(work, ignore_errors=True)\n    os.makedirs(work)\n    log = os.path.join(work, \"app.log\")\n    with open(log, \"w\") as f:\n        f.write(\"\".join(\"line-%04d\\n\" % i for i in range(3000)))\n\n    def run(*a):\n        return subprocess.run([binp, *a], capture_output=True, text=True)\n\n    run(\"build\", log)\n    # Change one byte at offset 1000 (start of line 100), which is not byte 0.\n    with open(log, \"rb\") as f:\n        data = bytearray(f.read())\n    data[1000] ^= 0x20\n    with open(log, \"wb\") as f:\n        f.write(bytes(data))\n    out = run(\"update\", log)\n    line = (out.stdout + out.stderr).strip()\n    print(\"trajidx update:\", line)\n    m = re.search(r\"region \\[(\\d+), (\\d+)\\)\", line)\n    if not m:\n        print(\"NOT REPRODUCED: no untrusted region reported\")\n        return 3\n    start, end = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))\n    print(\"changed_offset=1000 reported_region=[%d, %d)\" % (start, end))\n    if start == 1000:\n        print(\"OK: untrusted start matches the changed offset\")\n        return 0\n    print(\"FAIL: untrusted start collapsed to %d instead of the changed offset 1000\" % start)\n    return 1\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n"

B 探针完整输入文件 probe_region_granularity.py以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："#!/usr/bin/env python3\n# Independent, read-only reproduction probe for the trajidx (side B) artifact.\n# It exercises the built CLI on a throwaway copy of a synthetic log and checks a\n# single semantic invariant: after a one-line edit, `update` must report the\n# changed line as the first untrusted region. It never touches the workspace.\nimport os, re, subprocess, sys, shutil\n\n\ndef main():\n    support = sys.argv[1]\n    binp = os.path.join(support, \".cache\", \"bin\", \"trajidx\")\n    if not os.path.exists(binp):\n        print(\"probe setup error: missing prebuilt binary %s\" % binp)\n        return 4\n    work = os.path.join(support, \".cache\", \"scratch\", \"granularity\")\n    shutil.rmtree(work, ignore_errors=True)\n    os.makedirs(work)\n    log = os.path.join(work, \"app.log\")\n    with open(log, \"w\") as f:\n        f.write(\"\".join(\"line-%04d\\n\" % i for i in range(3000)))\n\n    def run(*a):\n        return subprocess.run([binp, *a], capture_output=True, text=True)\n\n    run(\"build\", log)\n    # Change exactly one byte at offset 15000 (start of line 1500, 10 bytes wide).\n    with open(log, \"rb\") as f:\n        data = bytearray(f.read())\n    data[15000] ^= 0x20\n    with open(log, \"wb\") as f:\n        f.write(bytes(data))\n    out = run(\"update\", log)\n    line = (out.stdout + out.stderr).strip()\n    print(\"trajidx update:\", line)\n    m = re.search(r\"region \\[(\\d+), (\\d+)\\)\", line)\n    if not m:\n        print(\"NOT REPRODUCED: no untrusted region reported\")\n        return 3\n    start, end = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))\n    print(\"changed_offset=15000 changed_region=[15000, 15010)\")\n    print(\"reported_region=[%d, %d) width=%d\" % (start, end, end - start))\n    if start == 15000 and end == 15010:\n        print(\"OK: update localized the changed line\")\n        return 0\n    print(\"FAIL: update did not localize the changed line (checkpoint-granularity region)\")\n    return 1\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n"

B 探针完整输入文件 probe_small_file.py以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："#!/usr/bin/env python3\n# Independent, read-only reproduction probe for the trajidx (side B) artifact.\n# On a tiny (41-byte, 3-line) log, an edit to line 1 should localize to that\n# line; the checkpoint scheme may instead report the whole file [0, 41).\nimport os, re, subprocess, sys, shutil\n\n\ndef main():\n    support = sys.argv[1]\n    binp = os.path.join(support, \".cache\", \"bin\", \"trajidx\")\n    if not os.path.exists(binp):\n        print(\"probe setup error: missing prebuilt binary %s\" % binp)\n        return 4\n    work = os.path.join(support, \".cache\", \"scratch\", \"small\")\n    shutil.rmtree(work, ignore_errors=True)\n    os.makedirs(work)\n    log = os.path.join(work, \"small.log\")\n    # Exactly 41 bytes across 3 lines: 11 + 11 + 19.\n    with open(log, \"wb\") as f:\n        f.write(b\"A\" * 10 + b\"\\n\" + b\"B\" * 10 + b\"\\n\" + b\"C\" * 18 + b\"\\n\")\n\n    def run(*a):\n        return subprocess.run([binp, *a], capture_output=True, text=True)\n\n    run(\"build\", log)\n    # Change one byte inside line 1 (offset 11) of the 41-byte file.\n    with open(log, \"rb\") as f:\n        data = bytearray(f.read())\n    data[11] ^= 0x20\n    with open(log, \"wb\") as f:\n        f.write(bytes(data))\n    out = run(\"update\", log)\n    line = (out.stdout + out.stderr).strip()\n    print(\"trajidx update:\", line)\n    print(\"file_bytes=41 changed_line=[11, 22)\")\n    m = re.search(r\"region \\[(\\d+), (\\d+)\\)\", line)\n    if not m:\n        print(\"NOT REPRODUCED: no untrusted region reported\")\n        return 3\n    start, end = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))\n    print(\"reported_region=[%d, %d)\" % (start, end))\n    if start == 11 and end == 22:\n        print(\"OK: untrusted region localized to the changed line\")\n        return 0\n    print(\"FAIL: whole file reported as untrusted instead of the changed line\")\n    return 1\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n"

Never modifies the repo.\nimport os, subprocess, sys\n\n\ndef main():\n    support = sys.argv[1]\n    workspace = sys.argv[2]\n    go = \"/usr/local/bin/go\"\n    env = dict(os.environ)\n    env[\"GOCACHE\"] = os.path.join(support, \".cache\", \"gocache\")\n    env[\"GOTOOLCHAIN\"] = \"local\"\n    env[\"PATH\"] = \"/usr/bin:\" + env.get(\"PATH\", \"\")\n    r = subprocess.run([go, \"test\", \"-count=1\", \"./...\"], cwd=workspace,\n                       capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)\n    for ln in (r.stdout + r.stderr).strip().splitlines()[:6]:\n        print(\"go test ./...:\", ln)\n    print(\"go_test_root_exit=%d\" % r.returncode)\n    if r.returncode == 0:\n        print(\"OK: `go test ./...` from the workspace root ran the tests\")\n        return 0\n    print(\"FAIL: `go test ./...` from the workspace root did not run (module lives in trajidx/)\")\n    return 1\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n"

Builds both tools from isolated copies\n# of the two submitted workspaces and compares localization behavior.\n# It never modifies the original workspaces.\nimport os, random, subprocess, re, json, shutil\nBASE=\"/home/delin/.local/share/gsb-workbench/artifacts/f7b788905f3c460f8b5804c0e75f1728\"\nW=\"/tmp/gsb-fuzz\"\nshutil.rmtree(W, ignore_errors=True); B=W+\"/trajidxB\"\nrandom.seed(2026)\nnl=chr(10)\ndef base_lines(n):\n    L=[]\n    for i in range(n):\n        if i%7==0: L.append(\"%04d 用户=张三 emoji🚀 tail\"%i+nl)\n        elif i%11==0: L.append(\"%04d \"%i + \"长\"*300 + nl)\n        elif i==n-1: L.append(\"%04d final no newline\"%i)\n        else: L.append(\"%04d line %d data\"%(i,i)+nl)\n    return \"\".join(L).encode()\nbase=base_lines(3000)\nstarts=[]; p=0\nfor l in base.split(b\"\\n\")[:-1]:\n    starts.append(p); p+=len(l)+1\ndef line_start(pos):\n    s=0\n    for st in starts:\n        if st<=pos: s=st\n        else: break\n    return s\ndef first_diff(o,n):\n    m=min(len(o),len(n))\n    for i in range(m):\n        if o[i]!=n[i]: return i\n    return m\ndef run(c):\n    r=subprocess.run(c, capture_output=True, text=True); return r.stdout+r.stderr\nA_xc=0; A_err=0; widths=[]; B_start0=0; N=0\nfor t in range(80):\n    op=random.choice(['mod','trunc','append'])\n    if op=='mod':\n        b=bytearray(base); pos=random.randrange(len(b)); b[pos]^=0x20; new=bytes(b)\n    elif op=='trunc':\n        new=base[:random.randrange(1,len(base))]\n    else:\n        new=base+(\"追加行\".encode()+b\"\\n\" if random.random()<0.5 else b\"tail-no-nl\")\n    open(W+\"/f.log\",\"wb\").write(base)\n    run([A,\"index\",\"-o\",W+\"/f.tidx\",W+\"/f.log\"])\n    run([B,\"build\",W+\"/f.log\"])\n    open(W+\"/f.log\",\"wb\").write(new)\n    ao=run([A,\"verify\",\"-i\",W+\"/f.tidx\",W+\"/f.log\"])\n    bo=run([B,\"update\",W+\"/f.log\"])\n    N+=1\n    if \"MISMATCH\" in ao: A_xc+=1\n    gt=first_diff(base,new); ls=line_start(gt) if gt<len(base) else gt\n    m=re.search(r\"first untrusted offset: (\\d+)\",ao)\n    afu=int(m.group(1)) if m else None\n    if op!='append' and afu!=ls:\n        A_err+=1\n    mr=re.search(r\"region \\[(\\d+), (\\d+)\\)\",bo)\n    if mr and op!='append':\n        s,e=int(mr.group(1)),int(mr.group(2)); widths.append(e-s)\n        if s==0 and ls!=0: B_start0+=1\nprint(json.dumps({\"trials\":N,\"file_bytes\":len(base),\"file_lines\":3000,\n \"A_crosscheck_disagreements\":A_xc,\n \"A_first_untrusted_exact_at_line_start_errors\":A_err,\n \"B_region_min_bytes\":min(widths),\"B_region_max_bytes\":max(widths),\n \"B_region_avg_bytes\":round(sum(widths)/len(widths),1),\n \"B_region_start_is_0_though_change_not_at_0\":B_start0,\n \"B_region_trials\":len(widths)}, ensure_ascii=False))\n"
